title: Prove one internal paired-star gap still needs thin rank at least q(g…
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

Proof, for one schedule family. On the paired-star contract, keep the two full calls of every stage adjacent, and allow thin maps in at most one gap between the halves of a single stage. The core-to-leaf coefficient of that gap is quadratic in the stage variable. In the eigenbasis of the half idempotent, the off-diagonal blocks of `B` stay free, and the coefficient meets the required monomial of at most three leaves. Every other leaf still forces

```text
total thin rank >= q (g-3).
```

At `g=31`, `q=26` the bound is **728**. Five thin maps of rank 26 have total rank **130**, so this schedule has no endpoint. The projectors need not commute.

This is a proof in the projector algebra plus an exhaustive comparison of square-free monomials. It is not a finite census of words or projectors, not a heuristic search, and not unrestricted nonexistence of the `g=31`, `q=26` profile. A second internal gap, one gap in every stage, nested intervals, and crossed intervals stay open. No witness is constructed.

No new kappa. The selected frontier stays `781451/250000000 = 0.003125804`. The older chronological floor `5q >= 4q+20` still passes at `q=26`. This note does not replace the consecutive bound `q g = 806` of open PR #7005, and it does not replace the adjacent-halves map count of open PR #7010.

## Task and overlap

Base: `17469fff78c22941280f04d39dc5a1faee09c840` (upstream `CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds` main, re-fetched at session start and before submission; both reads were this commit). Package: `research/g31-q26-internal-gap`. Head: `ec8ab41023fcf244e2bf790b13e829127d2e08e4`.

Catalogue card `joint-query-controller`, priority revision 8. Scope status: **changed**. The card asks about a changed query demand. The assigned question is open question 1 of open PR #7005, restricted to one internal thin gap.

Overlap: local notes at the base commit, 317 open PR records, and 6973 discussion records, fetched 2026-11-10. The phrase search returned no matches; the neighbours below were read directly.

- Open PR #7005 (`1750566c34c9fb117dc4afc4ce2bdacca7da036b`): consecutive halves and no internal thin map need total rank at least `q g = 806`. This package starts from the coefficient that PR leaves uncomputed. It does not rerun that theorem.
- Open PR #7010 (`32999d634cdd718ce6fb77648f54e4e674d7f395`): adjacent halves with the internal slot empty need `ceil(g/2)` thin maps. A call between the halves is outside that hypothesis. This package treats one thin map in that slot and does not take the interleaved schedule.
- Nested or crossing stage intervals are a different question and were not taken.
- The `g=3` finite censuses are not inputs and were not re-run. The `g=3`, `q=1` word in this package is a conjugation control.

No open PR found that computes this internal-gap coefficient or rules out total rank 130 for this schedule.

## Validation

Python 3.12, standard library only:

```sh
python3 scripts/research_package.py --package research/g31-q26-internal-gap --check-only
python3.12 scripts/research_package.py --package research/g31-q26-internal-gap
```

Registered replay passed: `PASS_G31_Q26_INTERNAL_GAP` with `lower_total_rank=728` and `profile_total_rank=130`. `scripts/check_research_commit.py --check-source-history` passed at `ec8ab41023fcf244e2bf790b13e829127d2e08e4`.

The checker proves the eigenbasis form of `B`, both half orders, the scalar stage factor, and the closed form of `VZU` with noncommuting letters. Dropping the off-diagonal solution makes the pure product fail. A direct `g=3`, `q=1` word with nonzero `B` matches the conjugated coefficient at every stage and both orders; two maps in the gap add, and the zero map does not. The exponent comparison and the gap count are exhaustive for every stage at `g=31`. Those checks raise `SystemExit`, and the same replay passed under `python3 -O`.

Not run: a search over two or more internal gaps, a census at `q=26`, nested or crossed placements, native transport, Lean, Docker, and a selected-frontier replay. `make frontier6030-verify` was not run.

## Credit

The paired-star contract, the chronological rank floor, and the commuting map-count are from PR #5747 (Ali Romman), including PR #5673, PR #5631, and PR #5617. Cinna Davis supplied the controller/simplex lineage those packages retain. Open PR #7005 asked for this coefficient. Open PR #7010 left the internal slot outside its map-count theorem.

Prepared by unpaidmoon with substantial Cursor Grok assistance. Apache-2.0.

## Open next questions

Linked from `research/g31-q26-internal-gap/TASK.json`:

- Can one internal thin gap in every stage meet the `g=31`, `q=26` endpoint with total thin rank 130? One gap leaves at least `g-3` leaves to the external count. First step: impose `P_s Z P_f = 0` from the squared monomial at one stage, then read the core-to-leaf block of the surviving degree-1 term.
- Does the internal map's contribution on its three leaves raise the external bound above `q(g-3)`? First step: bound the sum of the ranks of the three core blocks of one matrix of rank at most `q`, using `P_s Z P_f = 0`.

## Workflow feedback

`docs/research/current-priorities.md` on this main is still labelled priority revision 8 and quotes an older kappa. The selected record `781451/250000000` is the one used here. Fork `main` is not upstream main, so this draft is based on a pin of `17469fff78c22941280f04d39dc5a1faee09c840` rather than on fork `main`. Feedback discussion: https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1200
